vendor_and_service: Public cloud provider (SYS-10 landing zone, standby region, backup account)
tier_rationale: Hosts the TOS, EDI gateway, portal and backups; supports every High BIA process
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability, Confidentiality) plus bridge letter
subservice_organizations: None carved out for the services used
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must configure identity, network rules, encryption keys, logging and backups (shared responsibility). Mapped to P04 Customer and Shared rows (52 of 56). Company gaps: failover and restore testing (POAM-010)
availability_vs_bia: Region-level availability commitments exceed the BIA; the company RTO of 4 h depends on its own failover, which is untested (P05 finding 1)
incident_notification_terms: Provider notifies affected customers of security incidents per its published terms; no negotiated term
follow_up: Track POAM-010; re-review shared responsibility mapping after the failover test

tier_rationale: Authenticates all staff, cloud administrators and portal administration; single point of failure (P01 R-034)
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability) plus bridge letter
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 2 of 40 sampled provider staff access changes approved late; remediated
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must manage users, MFA policies, conditional access, break-glass accounts and reviews. Mapped to AC-2, IA-2(1), IA-2(2), AC-7. Company gaps: access reviews (POAM-001); TOS and gate server break-glass accounts (P01 R-034)
availability_vs_bia: Provider availability commitment 99.9% monthly; an outage would stop sign-in to the TOS (P05 MTD 4 to 8 h for High processes); cached sessions and break-glass accounts are the fallback
incident_notification_terms: Notice within 72 hours of confirming an incident affecting customer data
follow_up: Request the bridge letter; obtain the hosting provider assurance; test break-glass accounts quarterly

vendor_and_service: Managed security service provider (MSSP; SYS-13 operator) and its SIEM platform
tier_rationale: Privileged EDR agents on all servers and endpoints; holds security logs; supports detection for every process
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security) plus bridge letter; annual service review with detection tests
subservice_organizations: SIEM SaaS platform carved out (the MSSP relies on the platform provider's SOC 2)
exceptions_noted: 2 exceptions: high-severity escalation missed the 30-minute target in 2 of 40 samples; 1 analyst access review late. Management response: staffing added
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must maintain the escalation contact list, define log sources, approve containment for servers, and review monthly reports. Mapped to IR-4, SI-4, AU-6. Company gaps: T2 gate, TOS application and OT sources not onboarded (POAM-005, POAM-006, POAM-024)
availability_vs_bia: Not a recovery provider; the MSSP continuity plan is tested annually per the report
incident_notification_terms: Contract: call within 30 minutes on high severity; incident at the MSSP itself within 24 hours
follow_up: Obtain the SIEM platform SOC 2; track the escalation SLA monthly (P01 R-038)

vendor_and_service: TOS vendor (SYS-01 software licensor and remote support)
tier_rationale: Standing remote support access to the TOS; software updates run in the company account; supports BP-01 to BP-12
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security) covering software development, release and support operations plus bridge letter
subservice_organizations: Support desk tooling SaaS carved out
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 1 of 25 support staff kept customer access 9 days after a role change
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must approve and monitor vendor support sessions, test releases before production, and manage TOS roles. Mapped to MA-4, CM-3, AC-2. Company gaps: vendor support not yet through the privileged remote access service (POAM-003); update hashes not verified (P01 R-037)
availability_vs_bia: Support commitments only (4-hour response for priority 1); recovery of the TOS is the company's responsibility
incident_notification_terms: Contract: within 72 hours; Subpart F requires notice without delay (101.650(f)(2)); amendment requested (POAM-019)
follow_up: Move support to the privileged remote access service; verify update hashes; negotiate 24-hour notice at renewal
reviewer_and_date: TOS Application Manager and Security Manager, 2026-08-31

vendor_and_service: Privileged remote access service vendor (vendor sessions to IT and OT)
tier_rationale: Brokers all vendor remote sessions once POAM-003 closes, including to crane controllers
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability) or equivalent independent report
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer owns approvals, account management and session review. Mapped to AC-17, MA-4, IA-2(1)
availability_vs_bia: Service outage blocks vendor support but not operations (vendors can work on site)
follow_up: Obtain the report before onboarding the remaining 26 vendors; if none exists, require a security questionnaire and penetration test summary

vendor_and_service: T2 mobile harbor crane OEM (maintenance and remote diagnostics)
tier_rationale: Remote access to crane controllers at T2 (P01 R-003); supports BP-05 and BP-06
assurance_required: Independent security assessment of its remote support process, or a SOC 2 Type 2 covering remote service operations; contract security terms
report_type_and_period: None; the OEM states it has no SOC 2 report for its service organization
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must control remote access (POL-02 4.10) and hold its own copies of PLC programs. Company gaps: POAM-003, POAM-011
availability_vs_bia: OEM holds the only copies of T2 PLC programs today, so T2 recovery depends on the OEM (P05 finding 2)
follow_up: Contract amendment for notification, named accounts and log retention (POAM-019); obtain program copies (POAM-011); ask for the OEM's remote service security description
reviewer_and_date: Director of Maintenance and Engineering and Security Manager, 2026-09-02

vendor_and_service: Berth and yard scheduling optimization vendor (SYS-12, AI-001)
tier_rationale: API access to all TOS data; recommendations affect vessel and yard safety (P10)
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Confidentiality) plus AI data terms
report_type_and_period: None on file; vendor expects its first Type 1 report in 2027-Q1
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must scope the API key, approve every plan and monitor model behavior. Mapped to SA-9, AC-6, CA-7. Company gaps: P10 conditions (POAM-027)
availability_vs_bia: Not required for recovery (P05: manual planning)
follow_up: Security questionnaire and penetration test summary now; Type 1 report when issued; contract terms on data use and notice (P10 conditions)

vendor_and_service: SD-WAN provider (managed SD-WAN for T1, T2 and the depot)
tier_rationale: Carries all traffic between the sites and the cloud; supports every High BIA process
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability) plus bridge letter
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must review routing changes and keep the cellular backups at T2 and the depot. Mapped to SC-7, SC-8, CP-8
availability_vs_bia: Single circuit at T2 and the depot (P01 R-016); provider availability commitment not aligned to the T2 RTO
incident_notification_terms: Contract: notice within 24 hours of a security incident
follow_up: Obtain the report by 2026-12-31; second diverse circuit at T2

tier_rationale: Repository and pipeline access; can merge to production today (P07 SA-11); handles driver test data
assurance_required: Security questionnaire; secure development attestation; contract terms
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company controls release approval (after POAM-020) and production access
incident_notification_terms: No breach notice term (Fla. Stat. 501.171(6) requires 10 days for agents holding personal information)
follow_up: Contract amendment (POAM-019); no production data in development; branch protection (POAM-020)
